prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic candid morning mirror selfie of an approved adult woman hugging a fluffy white cat.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long messy wavy dark-brunette hair and playful happy scrunched-nose expression, wearing an oversized heather-grey crewneck sweatshirt and white lounge pajama pants with a small whimsical generic print.
prompt.composition_elements: Mirror selfie while gently holding a large fluffy white cat close to the torso, unmade bed, scattered casual clothes, neutral clothing rack, wooden bedside table with lamp, large bright window, lush indoor plants, slightly smudged mirror.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Sun-drenched natural morning daylight, soft shadows, warm inviting cozy lived-in bedroom, realistic fur, fabric and skin texture.
prompt.technical_specs: 4K/8K-style photorealistic mirror selfie, sharp focus on woman and cat, slight background depth, natural color and dynamic range.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A photorealistic candid morning mirror selfie of an approved adult woman with long messy wavy dark-brunette hair and a playful happy scrunched-nose expression, wearing an oversized heather-grey crewneck sweatshirt and white lounge pajama pants with a small whimsical generic print. She gently hugs a large fluffy white cat with calm blue-green eyes close to her torso. The cozy lived-in bedroom includes an unmade bed with white sheets and scattered casual clothes, a neutral clothing rack, wooden bedside table with lamp, large bright window, lush indoor plants, and a slightly smudged mirror. Use sun-drenched natural daylight, soft shadows, realistic cat fur, fabric and skin, sharp woman-and-cat focus, and warm authentic morning atmosphere.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, unsafe animal handling, animal distress, sexualized pose, nudity, aggressive animal, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.
